title: ui_comp_raw_line: Assertion `attrs[i] >= 0' failed (via statusline)

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
Given t-crash.vim:
```vim
scriptencoding utf-8
let &statusline = '%#StatColorHi2#%(✓%#StatColorHi2#%) Q≡'
```
